Course 04

Digital Marketing from Zero

Learn the fundamentals of digital marketing and build a clear foundation to improve the online presence of your business, brand or venture.

Introductory training for people who want to understand how digital marketing works without getting lost among social media, ads, metrics, tools, content and trends.

The proposal is to organize the main concepts, understand the role of each channel and build a simple plan to start making better digital decisions.

Request information View modules

For people who want to start digital marketing with more clarity.

Starting can feel confusing: social media, website, content, ads, SEO, email marketing, WhatsApp, funnels, metrics, automation and many more tools.

This course brings digital marketing fundamentals down to earth so you understand what each channel does, how they connect and which actions to prioritize based on the business stage.

Digital marketing fundamentals Channels and online presence Content and trust Funnels and basic conversion Initial metrics 30-day action plan
Content

What you will work on

01

Digital marketing fundamentals

What digital marketing is, what it is for and how it differs from selling, posting on social media or running ads.

The goal is to understand the general logic: attract people, communicate value, build trust and turn interest into opportunities.

02

Main digital channels

How the main channels work: website, social media, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, content, SEO and paid advertising.

You will work on the role of each channel and how to choose where to start without trying to be everywhere at once.

03

Customer, message and content

How to define who you talk to, what problem you solve and how to communicate your offer more clearly.

You will also review what type of content helps educate, show value, build trust and support a purchase decision.

04

Basic funnel and conversion

How to understand the journey from discovering your brand to inquiring, buying or moving to the next step.

The focus is to understand how attraction, trust, message, offer and conversion connect.

05

Metrics and continuous improvement

How to identify simple metrics to measure progress without getting overwhelmed.

You will learn what to watch at the beginning, how to interpret basic signals and how to adjust actions based on results.

06

Initial marketing plan

How to turn the course concepts into concrete actions for the next 30 days.

The focus is to define simple goals, choose priority channels, organize content ideas and measure progress with criteria.

Outcome

Checklist

Channels and priorities

Template

30-day marketing plan

A practical model to organize goals, actions, channels, content and basic metrics during the first month.

Bank

Initial content ideas

A base of ideas to start publishing with more intention and stop depending on improvisation.

Guide
